errors.title: Lake Formation permission denied
causes: role needs LF grant on database/table/columns
cross-account access missing resource-link or grant
fixes: grant the caller LF permissions (SELECT/INSERT/ALTER/DROP as needed) on the database/table/columns via aws_lakeformation_permissions or the console
for cross-account: create a resource link in the consumer account and grant DESCRIBE on the link plus the shared permission on the target

errors.title: Table version invalid
causes: governed table metadata drifted
concurrent commits invalidated the table version read at job start
fixes: retry after a catalog refresh; check LF transaction state
pin/refresh the table version used by the job run

errors.title: Credential vending failed
causes: registered location role cannot vend for the caller
S3 registered location misconfigured for the table
caller lacks DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS on the registered location
fixes: register the S3 prefix with an IAM role Lake Formation can assume (iam-role, not service-linked) and grant it S3 access
grant the job role DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS on the registered location
for Glue 5.x jobs: LF vends scoped credentials for writes - check the vending/write-path conflict if the job writes governed tables

errors.title: GetTemporaryCredentials denied
causes: caller principal lacks permission for credential vending on this table
hybrid access mode: principal not enrolled while IAMAllowedPrincipals grant exists
Glue 5.x write path requires vending even when reads succeed
fixes: grant the job role SELECT/INSERT on the table AND DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS on the underlying registered location
enroll the principal in hybrid access mode, or remove the IAMAllowedPrincipals grant
Glue 5.x + FGAC + write: ensure the registered-location role can vend scoped credentials for the write path

errors.title: Registered-location S3 deny
causes: table data lives under an S3 prefix that is not registered as an LF data location
registered-location role lacks s3:GetObject/PutObject on the prefix
fixes: register the S3 prefix via aws_lakeformation_resource (or RegisterResource) with a vending-capable role
grant the registered-location role S3 access to the exact prefix (no wildcard gaps)

errors.title: Resource link / cross-account access failed
causes: consumer account has no resource link to the shared database
RAM resource share missing or not accepted for the Data Catalog object
grant went to the linked name instead of the target
fixes: share the catalog object via aws_ram_resource_share + principal association to the consumer account
create the resource link in the consumer catalog and grant DESCRIBE on it

errors.title: IAMAllowedPrincipals / hybrid access conflict
causes: IAMAllowedPrincipals grant bypasses LF for principals not enrolled in hybrid access mode
principal behavior is ambiguous while both IAM grants and LF grants apply
fixes: enroll the job principal in hybrid access mode (aws_lakeformation_opt_in / DataLakePrincipal enrollments)
or remove the IAMAllowedPrincipals grant so LF is the only gate

errors.title: LF-Tag policy mismatch
causes: principal's LF-Tag grant expression does not cover the tagged resource
resource tagged with a key/value the principal grant does not include
fixes: grant the principal an LF-Tag expression matching the resource's tags (key + value pair, not just the key)
verify aws_lakeformation_resource_lf_tags actually attached the intended tag values

errors.title: DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS missing
causes: writes/DDL under a registered location need DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS on top of table grants
principal has table-level grants but not location-level access
fixes: grant DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS on the registered S3 location to the job role
for new tables under governed paths, register the prefix first

errors.title: Fine-grained (FGAC) access denied
causes: column-level or cell-level grants exclude the queried columns
data-cells filter excludes the rows/columns the job reads
fixes: extend the LF grant to cover the needed columns (column inclusion/exclusion lists)
check AWS::LakeFormation::DataCellsFilter / aws_lakeformation_data_cells_filter coverage
